raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

With `SGLANG_RUST_SERVER` set on a prefill worker, `handle_pd_disaggregation` aliases `--disaggregation-bootstrap-port` to `--port`, because the embedded Rust server answers the KV bootstrap registry on its API listener and every consumer of the resolved field (KVManager registration, `PrefillBootstrapQueue`) has to agree with it. That alias is only correct when the Rust registry really stands in for the transfer backend's bootstrap server, which is the case for the built-in backends: their `KVClassType.BOOTSTRAP_SERVER` is a `CommonKVBootstrapServer`, the HTTP registry the Rust server reimplements.

A transfer backend that brings a bootstrap server of its own, one that does not derive from `CommonKVBootstrapServer`, still runs that server on the configured bootstrap port. Rewriting the field to the API port then points the backend's registration at a port nothing of its own listens on, and a deliberately separate `--disaggregation-bootstrap-port` is rejected as a conflict with `--port`.

## Modifications

- `python/sglang/srt/managers/disagg_service.py`: add `rust_server_serves_kv_bootstrap(transfer_backend)`. It resolves the backend's bootstrap server class through `get_kv_class` and returns whether that class is a `CommonKVBootstrapServer`; a backend with no bootstrap server at all (`fake`) returns `False`.
- `python/sglang/srt/arg_groups/pd_disaggregation_hook.py`: `_alias_bootstrap_port_to_api_port` returns early, logging that the configured port is kept, when the helper returns `False`. The import is lazy so the argument hook does not import the disaggregation package at module import time and so a `get_kv_class` bound at runtime is the one consulted. The built-in backends take the same path as before.
- `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_rust_server_dp_ports.py`: `test_rust_prefill_bootstrap_port_alias` runs `handle_pd_disaggregation` on a prefill `ServerArgs` under `SGLANG_RUST_SERVER` with `get_kv_class` patched to a `CommonKVBootstrapServer` subclass or a bare `BaseKVBootstrapServer` subclass. The HTTP-registry cases keep the previous behaviour (default port aliased to `--port`, a port equal to `--port` kept, a separate port raises `conflicts with --port`); the own-bootstrap-server cases keep the default and a separate port as configured.

## Accuracy Tests

Argument resolution only; model forward and inference are untouched.

- `test/registered/unit/entrypoints/test_rust_server_dp_ports.py`: 37 tests pass on this branch (32 existing, 5 new parametrized cases of `test_rust_prefill_bootstrap_port_alias`).

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable: one extra class lookup at server-argument resolution time on Rust-server prefill.

## Checklist

- [x] Pre-commit checks pass on the changed files.
- [x] Unit tests added for the new behaviour.
- [ ] Documentation: no user-facing flag changes.

detail.title: [Fix] rust-server: Keep a transfer backend's own bootstrap port on prefill

files.patch:
@@ -248,8 +248,23 @@ def _alias_bootstrap_port_to_api_port(server_args: ServerArgs) -> None:
     consumer (KVManager registration, PrefillBootstrapQueue) reads the resolved
     field and agrees automatically. Decode is untouched: there the field names
     the PREFILL side's bootstrap port and must stay as the operator set it.
+    A transfer backend that brings its own bootstrap server keeps the port as
+    configured: that server, not the Rust registry, listens there.
     """
+    # Lazy: disagg_service pulls in the disaggregation package. Its helper calls
+    # disagg_service.get_kv_class, which a transfer backend registered at
+    # runtime may rebind.
+    from sglang.srt.managers.disagg_service import rust_server_serves_kv_bootstrap
+
     cfg = resolving_view(server_args)
+    if not rust_server_serves_kv_bootstrap(cfg.disaggregation_transfer_backend):
+        logger.info(
+            "SGLANG_RUST_SERVER: transfer backend %s runs its own KV bootstrap "
+            "server; keeping disaggregation_bootstrap_port %d",
+            cfg.disaggregation_transfer_backend,
+            cfg.disaggregation_bootstrap_port,
+        )
+        return
     default_port = next(
         f.default
         for f in record_fields(type(server_args))

@@ -51,6 +51,21 @@ def start_disagg_service():
         return bootstrap_server
 
 
+def rust_server_serves_kv_bootstrap(transfer_backend: str) -> bool:
+    """Whether the embedded Rust server's KV bootstrap registry stands in for
+    the transfer backend's bootstrap server: it ports ``CommonKVBootstrapServer``,
+    the HTTP registry the built-in backends run, but not a backend that brings
+    a bootstrap server of its own."""
+    from sglang.srt.disaggregation.common.conn import CommonKVBootstrapServer
+
+    server_class = get_kv_class(
+        TransferBackend(transfer_backend), KVClassType.BOOTSTRAP_SERVER
+    )
+    return server_class is not None and issubclass(
+        server_class, CommonKVBootstrapServer
+    )
+
+
 def maybe_create_ascend_config_store(transfer_backend: TransferBackend) -> None:
     """Also called directly by the rust-server scheduler: there the KV
     bootstrap registry is served by the embedded rust server's api listener

@@ -5,10 +5,17 @@
 import pytest
 
 from sglang.srt import rust_extensions
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import resolving_view
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.pd_disaggregation_hook import handle_pd_disaggregation
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.base.conn import BaseKVBootstrapServer
+from sglang.srt.disaggregation.common.conn import CommonKVBootstrapServer
 from sglang.srt.entrypoints.engine import node_hosts_rust_server
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.managers import disagg_service
 from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context, get_parallel
 from sglang.srt.rust_server import config as rust_config
 from sglang.srt.rust_server import server as rust_server
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
 
 register_cpu_ci(est_time=3, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
@@ -263,5 +270,49 @@ def test_scale_joiner_hosts_listener():
         assert node_hosts_rust_server()
 
 
+class _HttpRegistry(CommonKVBootstrapServer):
+    pass
+
+
+class _OwnBootstrapServer(BaseKVBootstrapServer):
+    pass
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "server_class,bootstrap_port,expected",
+    [
+        (_HttpRegistry, 8998, 31000),
+        (_HttpRegistry, 31000, 31000),
+        (_HttpRegistry, 33000, ValueError),
+        (_OwnBootstrapServer, 8998, 8998),
+        (_OwnBootstrapServer, 33000, 33000),
+    ],
+    ids=[
+        "http-registry-default",
+        "http-registry-shared",
+        "http-registry-separate",
+        "backend-bootstrap-server-default",
+        "backend-bootstrap-server-separate",
+    ],
+)
+def test_rust_prefill_bootstrap_port_alias(server_class, bootstrap_port, expected):
+    args = ServerArgs(
+        model_path="dummy",
+        port=31000,
+        disaggregation_mode="prefill",
+        disaggregation_bootstrap_port=bootstrap_port,
+    )
+    with (
+        envs.SGLANG_RUST_SERVER.override(True),
+        patch.object(disagg_service, "get_kv_class", return_value=server_class),
+    ):
+        if expected is ValueError:
+            with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="conflicts with --port"):
+                handle_pd_disaggregation(args)
+            return
+        handle_pd_disaggregation(args)
+    assert resolving_view(args).disaggregation_bootstrap_port == expected
+
+
 if __name__ == "__main__":
     raise SystemExit(pytest.main([__file__, "-v"]))
